status: analysis exploration lock; not a model; no version assigned
quinellaRanking: JRA official quinella pair market corrected with alpha=1.0 mean strict-OOS top2 horse-marginal log edge, ranked by corrected probability multiplied by JRA official quinella odds

C12.stakes: ranks1-6 x 200 yen; ranks7-12 x 100 yen

C15.stakes: ranks1-3 x 200 yen; ranks4-15 x 100 yen

mandatoryOtherTickets.win: 100 yen on top strict-OOS 164-feature win EV ticket
mandatoryOtherTickets.wide: 100 yen on top alpha=1.0 top3-marginal corrected wide EV ticket

structureFeatures: locked pre-race race/model features plus, for each structure, selected-ticket official-odds quantiles, market-rank summaries, corrected-score concentration, cumulative official-market mass, top2-edge summaries and overlap with top market tickets

coverage.target: whether the actual winning quinella is included in the structure

conditionalReturn.target: min(actual quinella return multiplier on the 1800-yen structure,5.0), trained only on prior races where the structure covered the winning quinella

predictedStructureReturn: coverageProbability multiplied by predicted conditional clipped return
structureChoice: choose the one of C9/C12/C15/C18 with highest predictedStructureReturn; ties prefer the narrower structure
predictedLightRaceReturn: 0.90*predicted chosen quinella structure return + 0.05*mandatory win pre-race EV + 0.05*mandatory wide pre-race EV
raceSelection: exactly five highest predictedLightRaceReturn races per raceDate x venue; never fewer
settlement: actual fixed-archive JRA payouts only; clipping is used only in structure-selection training targets, never in settlement
